title_zh: 凌晨三點的第七台洗衣機
title_en: The Seventh Washing Machine at 3 A.M.
story_zh: 凌晨三點，只有六台洗衣機的店裡，傳出第七台的轉動聲。我推門進去，地板上只有我的濕腳印。 燈一閃，角落多了台標著「7」的洗衣機。插頭掉在地上，滾筒裡卻翻著一件米色外套。 我身上正穿著那件外套。口袋裡多出一張取衣單，姓名是我，取件時間：三點零七分。 我轉身要走，店門竟鎖死。玻璃倒影裡七台機器全在轉；現實中，只有第七台發出聲音。 那台機器突然停住。圓窗裡浮出另一張我的臉，濕透的她雙掌貼著玻璃，無聲說：「別開門。」 手機震動：「您的衣物已洗好。」寄件號碼竟是我的手機。圓窗裡的她緩慢敲了三下。 三點零七分，機門自己彈開。裡面沒有女人，只有摺好的外套。我肩上的外套同時消失。 取衣單背後浮出小字：「第七台洗的是人。」我看向門玻璃：倒影穿著我的外套，正在微笑；我卻不再有倒影。
story_en: At three a.m., I entered a laundromat with six machines. A seventh drum was spinning somewhere in the dark. My wet footprints were the only ones. The lights flickered. Machine Seven appeared in the corner, spinning with its cord unplugged. A beige coat tumbled inside. It looked exactly like mine. I was wearing that coat. In its pocket, I found a collection receipt with my name on it. Pickup time: three oh seven. I ran for the door. Locked. In the glass, all seven machines were spinning. Behind me, only the seventh was moving. The seventh machine stopped. My own face appeared behind its round glass. The soaked woman pressed both hands against it, mouthing: Don't open the door. My phone buzzed. YOUR LAUNDRY IS READY. The sender was my own number. The woman behind the glass knocked three times, slowly. At three oh seven, the door opened. The woman was gone. Only a folded coat remained. The coat on my shoulders vanished. On the receipt, new words appeared: MACHINE SEVEN WASHES PEOPLE. In the glass, my reflection smiled, wearing my coat. I had no reflection anymore.
